body: 0 INTAKE. Anomaly: Dimensional scores Interest in Music Low (2); the regulation repertoire lists music as a cold-state tool (structured strong signal; switches channel). Expected: a gap between known and used tools (contradicted; prediction discarded). Arrived from: the Dimensional x AuDHD comparison, 2026-10-30. 1 LEVEL. Title: 'music'. Plot: a lifestyle interest (hobby, identity, consumption) vs a regulatory use. Theme: none shared; a tool used for a job needs no interest (breathwork, sour candy, caffeine). STOP: title-level coincidence. Nothing survives; logged as a failure, which is a result. Admissible as: nothing. Changes: the T5 tension is withdrawn. Does not license: concluding the music tool is used; Dimensional doesn't measure use. Trap: 'the app proves I use music to regulate.' Falsifier: if Dimensional's 'Interest in Music' items include using music to change mood, the level check fails and the tension returns.
plain: Ran intake on 'Interest in Music Low' vs music as a cold-state regulation tool: title-level only. Using something as a tool doesn't require an interest in it, so there is no tension.
